categories.main_business_segments: China Catalyst Holding Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of specialty molecular sieves and catalytic new materials, along with chemical technology and process services. Its main product categories include specialty molecular sieves and catalysts, non-molecular sieve catalysts, and catalytic application processes and chemical technology services. These products serve multiple industries including environmental protection and energy chemical sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced molecular sieve synthesis technologies, including CHA structure molecular sieves for automotive and industrial exhaust denitrification, titanium-silicon molecular sieves (TS-1) for green chemical synthesis, and ZSM series molecular sieves for petrochemical applications. Production involves crystallization, distillation, drying, calcination, ion exchange, and shaping processes. The company also develops metal catalysts and integrates chemical process packages such as HPPO for propylene oxide production. It maintains proprietary technologies for catalyst formulation, pore structure control, and industrial-scale manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global chemical giants such as BASF, and leading domestic enterprises in petrochemical, environmental protection, and fine chemical industries. The company’s products are used in automotive exhaust treatment, petrochemical refining, fine chemical synthesis, and environmental governance. Major markets include automotive emission control, energy chemical production, and industrial pollution control sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: China Catalyst operates primarily in China with headquarters in Dalian, Liaoning Province. It has established a sales network covering Asia-Pacific, Europe, North America, and Africa. The company exports a significant portion of its products, with overseas revenue growing substantially, reflecting its expanding international footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the chemical catalyst supply chain, focusing on the development and manufacturing of specialty molecular sieves and catalysts. It supplies critical catalytic materials and process technologies to downstream chemical producers and environmental technology firms.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing proprietary catalyst technologies, accelerating import substitution of high-end catalytic materials, and expanding into emerging sectors such as semiconductor and photovoltaic materials. The company emphasizes innovation in green chemistry, energy efficiency, and environmental catalysis, supported by a robust R&D system with over 248 patents and collaborations with leading research institutes and global partners like BASF.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of specialty molecular sieves, catalysts, and related chemical technology services. The company also earns income from licensing chemical process packages and providing customized technical solutions. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels to large industrial customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: China Catalyst is positioned as a leading domestic supplier in the specialty molecular sieve and catalyst industry, competing with international chemical giants in high-end catalyst markets. It holds a strong market position in China’s environmental catalysis and energy chemical sectors, with growing recognition in global supply chains, notably through strategic partnerships with BASF.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 666.6 million, a 21.23% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 145.5 million, up 89.21%. The company maintains a solid financial base with total assets around RMB 2.92 billion and equity of RMB 2.73 billion. Cash flow from operations improved significantly, reflecting strong sales growth and efficient receivables management.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: China Catalyst emphasizes its proprietary technology and high-performance specialty molecular sieves and catalysts that meet stringent environmental standards such as China VI for automotive emissions. Its products offer superior catalytic efficiency, stability, and cost-effectiveness, supporting green and energy-efficient chemical processes. The company’s integrated technology and service solutions, combined with strong R&D capabilities and intellectual property protection, differentiate it in the competitive catalyst market.
